positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Full Stack Developer working on PepsiCo's B2B platform across various LATAM and European countries.
- Application has generated $1b in revenue and 1+ million accounts to date.
- Frontend Development: Utilized React, JavaScript
- Backend Development: Java and Spring Boot to build scalable and efficient backend services. Implemented Cosmos DB for Apache Cassandra to handle high-availability, low-latency data storage and processing.
- Collaborations with cross-functional teams across LATAM regions to ensure smooth deployment and maintenance across multiple international markets.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · React Native · Java · Cassandra · Spring Boot
